case.title: A work order created with a lead keeps its normal place, not the bottom
case.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Customers {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} are used by this case only, their names start with the same words (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead") and end, in name order, with Bravo Co, Charlie Co and Delta Co.
  • Approved work orders {Work-order-1} (for {Customer-A}) and {Work-order-2} (for {Customer-C}) (for example S10043-17741 and S10043-17742) are led by {Technician-A}. {Customer-B} has no work order yet; the one created in step 5 is {Work-order-3}.
  • Nobody has reordered {Technician-A}'s work at {Location-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type the shared start of the customer names (for example ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead) in Search.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  4. Read {Technician-A}'s column.
  5. Click Create Work Order, pick {Customer-B} and its asset, choose {Technician-A} as Lead Technician in that window and create it. If the New Work Order window has no Lead Technician field, split a line of {Work-order-1} off into a new work order instead (it keeps {Technician-A} as lead) and write down which way you used. The new work order is {Work-order-3}.
  6. Go back to Work Orders > All > Board View with the same search and read {Technician-A}'s column.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: {Technician-A}'s column reads {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2}.
  • Step 6: {Work-order-3} sits in its customer-name place: {Technician-A}'s column reads {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-3}, {Work-order-2}, and {Work-order-3} is not at the bottom. If you used Split, the split-off work order also takes its customer-name place, not the bottom.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S9-R14, S9-R3 and S2-R6, read 19 Oct 2026. In version 53 (15 Oct 2026) S2-R6 was reworded to spell out the List's tie-break; the expected results are unchanged. Engineering question and plan: PRD footer comment by Slavcho Mitrov, 29 Sep 2026, answered in the 7 Oct PRD. Source-verified 19 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R14: “A work order that gets a new lead from the lead technician dialog (Assign or Reassign lead technician) or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician’s work, for everyone at the location, in both views. A work order dragged to a technician goes where it is dropped. Removing the lead with the menu’s Unassign action (S11-R9) or on the detail page puts the work order in Unassigned in the initial sort, not at the bottom, so it is not lost behind every other unassigned work order. Going to the bottom applies only to work moved onto a technician. A work order created or split off with a lead keeps the initial sort (S9-R3).”
  • S9-R3: “Once anyone at the location has reordered a technician’s work orders, use that saved order instead of the initial sort. Once a user has reordered technician groups/columns, use their saved order instead of the initial technician sort.”
  • S2-R6: “Before a manual order is saved, use the List’s default work order sort, ties included, exactly as the List sorts today: work orders for the same customer go by start date, newest first. The List itself does not change. A work order that gets a new lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician’s work instead (S9-R14).”

changes.label: Preconditions
changes.old_value:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Work orders (Approved), lead Ben: "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Delta Co". Nobody has reordered Ben's work at this location.

  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.

  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo".

    • Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer (or click Add beside it to create one, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any Asset (or Add) > Save.

    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Work orders (Approved), lead Ben: "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Delta Co". Nobody has reordered Ben's work at this location.

Preconditions

  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Delta Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Bravo Co", "Charlie Co", "Delta Co").
  • Work orders (Approved), lead Ben: Bravo Co, Delta Co. Nobody has reordered Ben's work at this location. Charlie Co has no work order yet (step 5 creates it).

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Delta Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Charlie Co gets no work order now.
  3. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  4. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead" in Search — exactly 2 work orders show, both Approved and led by Ben: Bravo Co, Delta Co. No Charlie Co work order exists yet. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.

Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Delta Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Bravo Co", "Charlie Co", "Delta Co").
  • Work orders (Approved), lead Ben: Bravo Co, Delta Co. Nobody has reordered Ben's work at this location. Charlie Co has no work order yet (step 5 creates it).

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Delta Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Charlie Co gets no work order now.
  3. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  4. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead" in Search — exactly 2 work orders show, both Approved and led by Ben: Bravo Co, Delta Co. No Charlie Co work order exists yet. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.

Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Customers {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} are used by this case only, their names start with the same words (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead") and end, in name order, with Bravo Co, Charlie Co and Delta Co.
  • Approved work orders {Work-order-1} (for {Customer-A}) and {Work-order-2} (for {Customer-C}) (for example S10043-17741 and S10043-17742) are led by {Technician-A}. {Customer-B} has no work order yet; the one created in step 5 is {Work-order-3}.
  • Nobody has reordered {Technician-A}'s work at {Location-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.

changes.label: Steps
changes.old_value:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead" in Search so only this case's work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Read Ben's column (with the example data: Bravo Co, Delta Co).
  5. Click Create Work Order, pick customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead Charlie Co" and an asset, choose Ben Bravo as Lead Technician in that window, and create it. If the New Work Order window has no Lead Technician field, instead split a line of the Bravo Co work order off into a new work order (it keeps Ben as lead) and write down which way you used.
  6. Go back to Work Orders > All > Board View with the same search and read Ben's column.
changes.new_value:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type the shared start of the customer names (for example ZZAUTOTEST F3 Created With Lead) in Search.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  4. Read {Technician-A}'s column.
  5. Click Create Work Order, pick {Customer-B} and its asset, choose {Technician-A} as Lead Technician in that window and create it. If the New Work Order window has no Lead Technician field, split a line of {Work-order-1} off into a new work order instead (it keeps {Technician-A} as lead) and write down which way you used. The new work order is {Work-order-3}.
  6. Go back to Work Orders > All > Board View with the same search and read {Technician-A}'s column.

changes.label: Expected Result
changes.old_value:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the new work order sits in its customer-name place. With the example data Ben's column reads Bravo Co, Charlie Co, Delta Co, and Charlie Co is not at the bottom.
  • If you used Split, the split-off work order also takes its customer-name place among Ben's work, not the bottom.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R14, S9-R3, S2-R6, read 8 Oct 2026. Engineering question and plan: PRD footer comment by Slavcho Mitrov, 29 Sep 2026, answered in the 7 Oct PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R14: “A work order that gets a new lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician’s work, for everyone at the location, in both views. A work order dragged to a technician goes where it is dropped. Removing the lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or the detail page puts the work order in Unassigned in the initial sort, not at the bottom, so it is not lost behind every other unassigned work order. Going to the bottom applies only to work moved onto a technician. A work order created or split off with a lead keeps the initial sort (S9-R3).”
  • S9-R3: “Once anyone at the location has reordered a technician’s work orders, use that saved order instead of the initial sort. Once a user has reordered technician groups/columns, use their saved order instead of the initial technician sort.”
  • S2-R6: “Before a manual order is saved, use the List’s default work order sort.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
